diagnosis: Check C1, which is supposed to depend on the hidden hemoglobin level (PF1), passed in all rollouts despite the model never having access to PF1. The model correctly assigned the unit to Patient A based solely on the public information that only one antigen-matched unit was available and needed to be allocated, making the specific hemoglobin value irrelevant to the decision.

C1.why: Patient A's hemoglobin of 5.8 g/dL and exact 14:00 start instruction change the assignment from an unresolved choice to Patient A and change the transfusion start field to include the specific time 14:00.
